product.name: Harnessie
product.description: A brain-agnostic multi-agent harness with consent, workspace confinement, independent verification, human-only arbitration, and tamper-evident audit records.

capabilities.name: Review a Harnessie checkout
capabilities.description: A bounded GuideCheck guide for inspecting a checkout and reporting evidence before a human authorizes any action.

capabilities.name: Verify claims about a local artifact
capabilities.description: Runs deterministic checks before an independent fresh-context verifier and exits fail-closed when a verdict cannot be earned.

capabilities.name: Run a governed local workflow
capabilities.description: Runs consented task packets with declared budgets, ownership lanes, OS-sandboxed shell work, verification gates, and audited stop conditions.

boundaries.note: Harnessie is installed and run locally. These declarations describe its shipped CLI and review surfaces; they do not advertise a hosted agent, API, or MCP server.
